_README: Copy this file to secrets.local.json and fill in your own values.
secrets.local.json is gitignored - never commit it, and never put real hosts or passwords
Only the environments you list here appear in the UI dropdown, alongside the built-in Local.
fe_host        (required) StarRocks FE host, used for the Stream Load PUT
be_host        (optional) host substituted into the FE's 307 redirect; defaults to fe_host
mysql_port     (optional) MySQL protocol port for read-only queries, default 9030
confirm_phrase (optional) when set, the UI makes you type it before Start Sync
note           (optional) shown under the environment dropdown

PROD.note: Private address - requires VPN. Insert-only, as everywhere.
